title: Bench Joiner
intro: A specialist manufacturer in Newton Aycliffe is growing its production team and is looking for Bench Joiners, or people with transferable joinery and manufacturing skills. You will make high quality products from solid surface materials and washroom products, using tools and machinery much like those found in a bench joinery workshop.
bullets: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:00pm (37.5 hours a week)
£14.50 to £17.50 an hour depending on experience
Regular overtime available on weekdays and weekends
Mainly factory based, with nationwide installation work when required
also: This role would also suit Cabinet Makers, Shopfitters, Joinery Machinists, Fabricators and anyone with a manufacturing or fabrication background who is confident with joinery tools and machinery.
outro: This form takes around 8 minutes. The more detail you give, the easier it is for us to put you forward.
